subject: Sportfishing yacht with tuna tower trolling offshore, outriggers deployed
alt: Sportfishing yacht with tuna tower trolling offshore in deep blue water, outriggers spread
author: hh oldman
notes: Hero-worthy (3594px source): the boat underway in deep blue water with crew in the cockpit. The hull name 'Maggie Joe' is legible, so consider cropping for branding. Probably Hawaii (photographer's set).

subject: Express sportfisher with tuna tower running through Hillsboro Inlet, Florida
alt: Sportfishing boat with tuna tower cruising past palm trees and a lighthouse in turquoise water
author: Richard Mc Neil
notes: Inlet setting (Hillsboro Inlet Lighthouse, Florida) with palms. Tropical look. A building sits at the left edge.

subject: Sportfishing boats with tuna towers moored at a marina dock (Oranjestad, Aruba)
alt: Sportfishing boats with tall tuna towers and outriggers moored at a palm-lined marina dock
author: Ein Dahmer
notes: Shot in Aruba. Registration 'A-655' on the hull. Palms and hotel in the background.

subject: Boston Whaler 240 Outrage center-console boat running at speed
alt: Center-console fishing boat with T-top and rod holders running fast behind an outboard motor
author: kees torn
notes: Accurate center console with T-top, rocket launcher and rods. Cropped to remove a container port and ship hull at the top. A rock jetty edge remains behind the boat. Shot in the Netherlands, not tropical. Only 2332px source, wide panoramic crop. Registration '06-83-YS' is visible.

subject: Luxury motor yacht Sequel P cruising at sea
alt: Luxury motor yacht with dark hull and white superstructure cruising on open sea
author: Alex Proimos
notes: Superyacht underway. The name 'Sequel P' is faintly legible on the side.

subject: Sportfisher with outriggers, rocket-launcher rods and crew on deck (Bermuda)
alt: Sportfishing boat with tall outriggers, rods in rocket launchers and crew on the cockpit deck
author: Grander13
notes: Charter boat in Bermuda. Shows outriggers, rod rack and tower helm. Transom name 'Anita Jean' is visible. Crew and passengers are small in frame. No photo of a trolling spread in the water was found.

subject: Angler in a fighting harness battling a big fish with a bent rod offshore (Gulf of Mexico)
alt: Angler in a harness fighting a big fish with a deeply bent rod on the open ocean
author: Lsuff
notes: Seen from behind and to the side. Stand-up harness, not a fighting chair: no fighting-chair photo with an allowed license was found. Source is 2048px wide.

subject: Gold big-game lever-drag reel on a heavy trolling rod in a boat rod holder
alt: Gold big-game trolling reel on a heavy rod set in a boat rod holder above calm blue sea
author: Tanguy Carpaye-Taïlamée
notes: Portrait orientation. The reel sits in the lower half and the rod tip runs against the sky. Shallow focus on the reel.

subject: Three hand-painted saltwater popper lures (GT poppers)
alt: Three hand-painted saltwater popper lures in green, orange and red patterns on a white background
author: Stalane
notes: SUBSTITUTE: no skirted offshore trolling lures under an allowed license were found. These are big saltwater topwater poppers (GT poppers), the type used for roosterfish, tuna and jacks in Costa Rica. Studio shot on white.

subject: Angler wading a saltwater flat while fly casting (Florida Keys)
alt: Angler wading a calm saltwater flat while fly casting, line looping through the air
author: NOAA Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary
notes: Real saltwater fly fishing on the flats in the Florida Keys. The angler's face is visible (sunglasses). Soft, pale sky.

subject: Angler leaning over the gunwale to tag and release a sailfish
alt: Angler leaning over the side of a boat to tag and release a sailfish in green-blue water
author: Derke Snodgrass, NOAA/NMFS/SEFSC
notes: NOAA tag-and-release of a large sailfish (Istiophorus platypterus), with the tag visible on its back. Portrait orientation. NOAA staffer's face visible. Alternative: fish/sailfish-2 is also a release shot from Costa Rica.

subject: Family on a boat helping a young child land a fish
alt: Parents on a boat helping an excited young child in a life jacket hold up a freshly caught fish
author: Gentry George, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
notes: Lake bass boat, not offshore. Mercury and Nitro brand logos are visible. Warm, genuine family moment.

subject: Boat captain at the wheel inside a wheelhouse, seen from behind
alt: Boat captain in an orange jacket steering at the helm inside a wheelhouse
author: Garrett Parker (via Unsplash)
notes: Originally an Unsplash photo released CC0, mirrored on Commons. Seen from behind. Bright, airy, slightly filmic look. Puget Sound, USA.

subject: Vast deep-blue open ocean to the horizon with a lone white yacht
alt: Vast deep-blue open ocean stretching to the horizon with a lone white yacht far offshore
author: Jonas Nilsson Lee
notes: CC0. Calm deep blue sea and a clear horizon, with a small white motor yacht in the lower centre that gives scale. Good as a section background.

subject: Traditional fiberglass panga with outboard on a lagoon shore (Guerrero, Mexico)
alt: Traditional fiberglass panga boat with outboard motor beached in shallow water as a fisherman wades nearby
author: Alejandro Linares Garcia
notes: Classic Latin American panga, the same type used inshore in Costa Rica. Laguna de Chautengo, Mexico. A local man wades in the background.

subject: Snorkeler diving over sand and rocks in clear turquoise tropical water
alt: Snorkeler with fins diving over white sand and rocks in clear turquoise tropical water
author: Jakob Owens (via Unsplash)
notes: Originally an Unsplash photo released CC0, mirrored on Commons. Shot in the Bahamas.
